findings.title: BNC Service Disruption Notification - Eastern District of Texas
findings.summary_md: The Eastern District of Texas bankruptcy court posted a service-disruption notice on October 13, 2026. It states that late on Friday, October 9, 2026, BAE Systems notified the Administrative Office of a disruption to the Bankruptcy Noticing Center systems and related websites, including bnc.uscourts.gov, bankruptcynotices.uscourts.gov, notices.uscourts.gov, and the National Creditor Registration Service.

findings.title: Notice of Bankruptcy Noticing Center Service Outage - Northern District of Georgia
findings.summary_md: The Northern District of Georgia posted a notice dated October 13, 2026 confirming the nationwide BNC service disruption. It lists the same affected BAE-operated websites and notes BAE Systems is actively investigating and working to restore services, confirming the contractor-level incident predates the Administrative Office's October 15 disclosure.
